meta.name: agent-governance
meta.description:
Patterns and techniques for adding governance, safety, and trust controls to AI agent systems. Use this skill when:
- Building AI agents that call external tools (APIs, databases, file systems)
- Implementing policy-based access controls for agent tool usage
- Adding semantic intent classification to detect dangerous prompts
- Creating trust scoring systems for multi-agent workflows
- Building audit trails for agent actions and decisions
- Enforcing rate limits, content filters, or tool restrictions on agents
- Working with any agent framework (PydanticAI, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents, LangChain, AutoGen)

copy.tagline: 为AI智能体加上权限审核与安全护栏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Python 开发会调用外部工具的 AI 智能体
copy.tagline_en: Add governance and safety controls to AI agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents that call external tools and need trust controls

howto.what: 这个技能提供把治理规则加到 AI 代理上的代码模式：设定可用工具清单、拦截危险内容、限制调用次数、记录每次操作的审计日志，并按历史表现给代理打分。装上后，Claude 能帮你设计这类安全控制。
howto.when: 当你在开发会调用外部工具的 AI 代理，或需要给它加权限控制、危险提示检测、审计追踪等治理能力时。

say.text: 帮我给 AI 代理设个工具白名单，只允许查数据库和发邮件。
say.note: 会生成一个治理策略，代理只能调用这些工具。

say.text: 给代理加规则：调用外部 API 前先检查有没有危险关键词。
say.note: 执行前会拦截匹配敏感词的内容并拒绝。

say.text: 把代理每次调用工具的操作都记成审计日志，存成文件。
say.note: 启用审计追踪，记录时间、工具和结果。

howto.what_en: This skill provides code patterns to add safety controls to AI agents: defining allowed tools, blocking dangerous content, rate limiting, audit logging, and trust scoring for agents.
howto.when_en: Use when building AI agents that call external tools (APIs, databases, etc.) or when adding access controls, dangerous-prompt detection, audit trails, or other governance measures.

say_en.text: Set up a tool allowlist for my AI agent: only query_db and send_email.
say_en.note: Generates a policy object limiting tools.

say_en.text: Add a rule to scan for dangerous keywords before the agent calls external APIs.
say_en.note: It rejects content matching sensitive patterns before execution.

say_en.text: Log every tool call my agent makes to an audit file.
say_en.note: Enables an append-only audit trail with timestamps.
